about: A1 Master Mentalist for The Lost Relics; E6 Abbadona as the harp event spawn

entries.source: CapnBry radar: Master Mentalist (mob 2302), Tir na Nog zone 209 local 15219,20602 z 7187, level 51; Allakhazam quest The Lost Relics (1796): "he sends you to the Master Mentalist in the Chamber of Magic"
entries.why: no Master Mentalist existed, so steps 4 and 7 pointed at realm-1 Albion Master Elementalists in Emain Macha; a peaceful Hibernian Master Mentalist now stands at his CapnBry spot in the Chamber of Magic (beside the Mentalist/Enchanter/Eldritch trainers), copied from the trainer Ena's row

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(TargetName, 'Master Elementalist;200', 'Master Mentalist;201') WHERE ID BETWEEN 21441 AND 21454 AND Name = 'The Lost Relics'
entries.why: steps 4 and 7 ("ask the master mentalist in the Chamber of Magic") targeted Master Elementalist;200 (Albion NPCs in Emain Macha); they now target the Hibernian Master Mentalist in Tir na Nog
